releaseNotes:
NextGenSoftware.OASIS.API.Providers.OracleDBOASIS v2.0.3

Connects the OASIS to Oracle Database — the world's most widely used enterprise RDBMS. Stores OASIS holons and avatars using Oracle.ManagedDataAccess.Core with indexed lookup columns and full JSON serialisation via CLOB. Compatible with Oracle Database 12c+ and Oracle Autonomous Database. Part of the OASIS HOT-Swappable Provider Architecture. Ecosystem: https://oasisomniverse.one
